mode.title: Mode
mode.description: search collects listings from the portal sources in profile.filters.sources (Sreality and Bezrealitky are registered; iDNES follows). katastr_lookup returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

profile.title: Search profile
profile.description: Search profile, validated against profile.schema.json. See README.md.

notion.title: Notion
notion.description: Notion target. Without dataSourceId, results go to the dataset only. With it, the Notion schema is checked before any portal is contacted.

dataSourceId.title: Data source ID
dataSourceId.description: Notion data source ID of the DOMOVOY shortlist database.

notionToken.title: Notion token
notionToken.description: Notion integration token. Falls back to the environment variable NOTION_TOKEN (Apify secret notionToken).

llm.title: LLM settings
llm.description: Extraction settings. Each listing is tried on the Featherless model (Qwen, two attempts within the per-flat budget), then once on the OpenAI fallback model (gpt-6-luna, reasoning effort medium).

model.title: Model
model.description: Primary Featherless model id (Qwen). Tried with two attempts before the fallback.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: OpenAI fallback model, the only fallback: tried once, at reasoning effort medium, when Qwen has no valid answer. Needs an OpenAI key. Id checked on GET /v1/models.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Featherless concurrent units the run may hold at once. A Qwen3-30B call takes 1 unit; OpenAI fallback calls take none. The plan allows 100 (GET /v1/plan).

timeoutSec.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSec.description: Timeout per Qwen call attempt. Answers take 7 to 12 s, a cold first call 5 to 15 s. The OpenAI fallback gets at least 30 s.

flatBudgetSec.title: Per-flat budget (seconds)
flatBudgetSec.description: Time one flat may spend inside Qwen requests (waiting for a slot does not count). Then the OpenAI fallback gets one call. If the flat still has no answer and time ran out, it goes on with extraction status timeout and 'fees not extracted yet' in its unknowns; nothing is cached, so the next run extracts it again and delivers it as changed.

featherlessApiKey.title: Featherless API key
featherlessApiKey.description: Featherless API key for the primary and fallback models. Falls back to the environment variable FEATHERLESS_API_KEY (Apify secret featherlessApiKey).

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for the fallback model (llm.fallbackModel, gpt-6-luna), tried when Qwen has no valid answer. Falls back to the environment variable OPENAI_API_KEY (Apify secret openaiApiKey).

includeUnchanged.title: Include unchanged flats
includeUnchanged.description: Push flats that did not change since the last run to the dataset. With this on, unchanged flats are also written to Notion again (idempotent by Property ID; Status is never overwritten).

skipExtraction.title: Skip extraction
skipExtraction.description: Debug only. Skips the LLM extraction; costs and requirements then run on unknown fields.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Off. Apify Proxy is paid, so turning it on is a team decision.
